Rubrik Software Engineers are self-starters, driven, and can manage themselves. We believe in giving engineers responsibility, not tasks. Our goal is to motivate and challenge people to do their best work.  Bottom line, if you have a limitless drive and like to win, we want to talk to you - come make history! 

What you’ll do:

  • Build software using your strong background in distributed systems and cloud.

Experience you’ll need:

About Team

The International Analytics team India is looking for experienced product analyst who will support product, engineering and leadership team with insights gained from analyzing product and business data. They must have a proven ability to drive business results with their data-based insights.

What you will do

The International Analytics team India is looking for experienced product analyst who will support product, engineering and leadership team with insights gained from analyzing product and business data. They must have a proven ability to drive business results with their data-based insights. They must be comfortable working with a wide range of stakeholders and functional teams. The right candidate will have a passion for discovering solutions hidden in large data sets and working with stakeholders to improve business outcomes. The candidate will work across a family of areas (e.g. customer engagement, digital experience, merchandising, Supply chain, financial services, Operations) to help set the vision for creating amazing products.

• Define metrics, drive roadmaps, and uncover opportunities to improve our products.
• Have a strong bias towards action, enjoy finding patterns amidst chaos, and have demonstrated success in using analytics to drive business impact.
• Has the technical skills to surface insights quickly, and the interpersonal skills to communicate those insights in a way that persuades action.
• Work with your team to develop new analytic methods
• Use quantitative analysis and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand what drives our business
• Actively leverage AI/GenAI tools to enhance analytical productivity, automate repetitive workflows, and accelerate the journey from data to actionable insights.
• Partner with product leaders, designers, and engineering managers to improve our products and prioritize projects for impact.
• Represent the product analytics team in key meetings and business reviews with our executive team and founders
• Provide data driven insights and deliver recommendations that address opportunities for product improvements
• Use statistical methods to generate and test hypotheses. This includes Performing analytical deep dives to identify problems, opportunities and actions required; Collecting, processing, and cleaning data from disparate sources using SQL, R, Python, or other scripting and statistical tools
• Managing the design, execution, and analysis of A/B tests; driving rigor and testing culture through product teams

What you will Bring

• 2-6 years of experience of working in a high growth analytics team.
• Fluency in SQL, as well as an understanding of statistical analysis, and common pitfalls of data analysis. Basic understanding of query logic is a MUST.
• Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Business Administration or related field. Relevant experience in Product analytics will be a PLUS.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams.
• Strong problem-solving skills with an emphasis on product development.

Headquarters: 

About the Client
Our client is involved in an innovative data-collection project, which focuses on creating video datasets for training AI models. These AI models are designed to learn from first-person (POV) video footage. The captured videos depict real people involved in hands-on tasks with a mounted phone on their head or chest, paired with spoken narration. The purpose is to enable the model to connect visual inputs (objects, hands, actions) with audio descriptions.
Sub-areas for the videos
• Home & Daily Tasks: cleaning; laundry (sorting, folding); organizing a closet; house tours; pet care; packing luggage; loading appliances / dishwashing
• Repairs & DIY: home repair; gardening / farming; furniture assembly; woodworking; plumbing; electrical work; bicycle maintenance; soldering electronics
• Textile & Craft Arts: sewing; knitting; crocheting; using a loom; leathercrafting; bookbinding; crafting jewelry; pottery / ceramics
• Professional Trades & Industrial: automotive repair / maintenance; warehousing / logistics; construction / woodworking; laboratory work; operating heavy machinery controls; assembly-line packaging
• Hobbies & Arts: art – drawing; art – ceramics; art – painting; playing instruments; model building; outdoor survival / camping; calligraphy
• Technology & Computing: using computers or devices (e.g. audio mixers); gaming; product demos; VR / AR interaction; 3D printer setup / maintenance
• Outdoors & Activity: city tours; shopping; navigating public transit
• Personal Care: haircut; applying makeup; detailed grooming routines
• Specialized & Professional: medical procedures; first aid training; professional barista workflows; culinary chef / knife work; lab protocols (pipetting, titrations)
About the Role - Narrator
Watches the POV video and describes the scene and task in first person, in English, as if explaining it to a model that can't see. Fluency and describing ability matter most; knowing the activity is not required.
• Deliverable — audio narration synced to the video, recorded after the footage
• Language — English; fluency is criterion #1
• Density — at least 25 words/min on average, no long silences
• Content — 90%+ about the setting or task steps
Required Skills
• English fluency
• Ability to narrate pre-recorded videos
• All details on the Acceptance Criteria will be shared prior to the work.
Rules
• No personal data on video — third-party faces, screens, documents, plates, addresses, mirror reflections.
• 100% human narration — no TTS or synthetic voice.
Engagement Details
• Compensation model: Hourly paid, considering the total number of hours for approved videos.
• Commitment Type: Flexible hours based on video submissions.
• Duration: Ongoing, with earnings based on the number of approved videos.
• Location: Remote, with flexible overlap with client's timezone.
• Start Date: Immediate start upon approval of test video.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-narrator-videos-for-data-collection-project-ai-training

dbe6ec85cd7c6e78.description: **About ASBL** ASBL is a technology-driven real estate organization building in-house products and platforms to solve complex business and operational challenges across the real estate lifecycle. We are looking for a **Product Manager** to join our CRM Product team and work at the intersection of Business, Operations, and Technology. This role is highly **operations-focused**. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working close to business teams, understanding complex operational processes, identifying inefficiencies, and converting them into scalable product solutions. **Role Overview** As a Product Manager , you will own product initiatives for the CRM platform with a strong focus on business operations, process efficiency, workflow management, and problem-solving. You will work closely with operational and business teams to understand how work is actually executed on the ground, identify bottlenecks and gaps, and build technology-led solutions that improve productivity, visibility, control, and customer experience. This role requires strong **execution ownership** — from understanding the problem and mapping the existing process to defining the solution, working with technology teams, driving implementation, and ensuring adoption. **Key Responsibilities** **Business Operations & Process Ownership** * Work closely with business and operations teams to understand **end-to-end processes, workflows, dependencies, and operational challenges**. * Identify process inefficiencies, bottlenecks, manual interventions, control gaps, and recurring operational problems. * Map current-state processes and design improved **future-state workflows** using product and technology solutions. * Understand the operational impact of product decisions and ensure solutions are practical and scalable for business users. * Identify opportunities for **automation, process simplification, standardization, and improved operational control**. * Act as a bridge between business operations and technology teams to ensure business problems are translated into effective product solutions. **Product Management & Execution** * Own CRM product initiatives from **problem identification through solution definition, development, launch, and adoption**. * Convert operational and business requirements into clear product requirements, workflows, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Define product priorities based on business impact, operational criticality, customer impact, and feasibility. * Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and business stakeholders to drive execution. * Participate actively throughout development to ensure the solution addresses the underlying business problem rather than simply implementing a stated requirement. * Drive timely resolution of dependencies, issues, and ambiguities during execution. **CRM & Customer Journey** * Develop a strong understanding of the **customer lifecycle and CRM journey**, including interactions across business and operational teams. * Identify gaps in customer journeys, lead management, follow-ups, workflows, handoffs, and service processes. * Improve CRM workflows to enable better visibility, accountability, productivity, and customer experience. * Build solutions that enable business teams to manage customer and operational processes more effectively. **Cross-functional Stakeholder Management** * Work closely with **Business, Sales, Operations, Technology, Design, Data, and leadership teams**. * Engage directly with operational stakeholders to understand problems at their source. * Challenge existing processes and requirements where necessary and identify better ways of solving the underlying problem. * Drive alignment across multiple stakeholders and manage competing requirements and priorities. * Communicate product decisions, trade-offs, priorities, and outcomes clearly. **Product Adoption & Continuous Improvement** * Drive successful implementation and adoption of new CRM capabilities across business teams. * Monitor usage, operational outcomes, and user feedback after product launches. * Identify gaps between intended and actual process adoption and work towards improving them. * Use data and stakeholder feedback to continuously improve workflows and product capabilities. * Measure the impact of product initiatives through relevant **business, operational, customer, and product metrics**. **What We're Looking For** * **3+ years of experience in Product Management**, preferably in a business/operations-heavy environment. * Strong experience working closely with **Business and Operations teams** rather than working purely within a technology/product environment. * Demonstrated experience in understanding and improving **complex business processes and operational workflows**. * Strong ability to identify the **root cause of operational problems** and translate them into scalable product solutions. * Experience driving initiatives from **problem identification to execution and adoption**. * Strong understanding of customer journeys, business processes, workflows, and operational dependencies. * Ability to work effectively with both **business stakeholders and technology teams**. * Strong ownership and execution mindset with the ability to drive initiatives independently. * Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-paced, and highly execution-oriented environments. * Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. **Preferred Experience** * Experience working across **B2B and B2C products**. * Experience building or managing **CRM, workflow, sales, customer lifecycle, operations, or process-management products**. * Experience in **FinTech, lending, BFSI, financial products, payments, or related domains** is an added advantage. * Experience in organizations where Product teams work closely with **large operational/business teams**. * Experience with process automation, workflow digitization, and operational efficiency initiatives. * Experience using product and business data to identify operational problems and measure improvements. **Ideal Candidate Profile** We are looking for someone who is: **Operations-first | Business-oriented | Strong problem solver | Execution-focused | Product-minded | High ownership** The ideal candidate should be someone who can go beyond simply documenting requirements. They should be able to **deeply understand how a business process works, identify what is broken or inefficient, challenge existing ways of working, define a better solution, and drive the solution through technology to measurable business impact.** **Success in This Role** **Success will be measured by the ability to:** * Solve meaningful **business and operational problems** through product. * Simplify and improve complex workflows and processes. * Reduce manual effort and operational inefficiencies. * Improve visibility, accountability, and control across CRM processes. * Drive adoption of CRM capabilities across business teams. * Deliver product initiatives with strong execution and stakeholder alignment. * Demonstrate measurable improvement in **business and operational outcomes**.
